purpose: Pole/zero adjoint optimization of the wavelength-pivoted symmetric Sb2Se3 HCG at 1550 nm over the full crystalline-fraction range

pole_anchor.note: Fixed Chen time-reversal pole constraint at the shared material state n=3.48; target is geometrically scaled with the baseline.

claim_limit: Only prescribed complex pole and reflection-channel zero constraints enter the adjoint objective; held-out T and phase are validation. Lossless 1550-nm endpoint effective-medium model, not a measured continuous-state result.
